original_test_intent: Install and run the exact NVIDIA NVCert 3.4 harness for the approved platform/SKU, capture all scoped check evidence, restore platform health and obtain NVIDIA's review disposition.
original_method: Obtain signed/provenanced harness, checksum/license, pinned install guide/script and exact SKU config; inventory prerequisites and back up affected configuration; use a dedicated isolated SUT with stable power/cooling/OOB; preserve logs; approve every state-changing check and stop/recovery path; install/run once, record per-check results and send immutable evidence to NVIDIA.
manual_activity: NVIDIA/platform owner supplies harness, SKU config, script and result-review path; lab operator prepares dedicated SUT, backups, OOB and recovery and authorizes destructive checks.
required_inputs: Exact platform/SKU config and compatibility matrix
Pinned 3.4 install guide and install/run scripts
safety_requirements: Never execute an unscoped certification script
Preserve full install/run and system evidence
Use dedicated isolated SUT with OOB/redundant power
agent_execution_scope: Collect every check and platform-health result

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat certification as a vendor-controlled, allowlisted sequence with immutable artifacts/config, per-check state tracking, checkpoints, rollback and external disposition.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds executable identity, per-check scope, dedicated-SUT safety and final vendor decision trail.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Installation success alone does not satisfy certification-run or NVIDIA-review coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Unknown harness checks may alter firmware, storage, services or device state and require recovery.

project_override_considerations: Certification owner must state which NVCert checks are in scope for this SKU, allowed skips, destructive targets, reboot/firmware semantics and what NVIDIA response constitutes acceptance.
expected_evidence: Per-check scope, commands, outputs/exits and mutations
NVIDIA submission identifier and review disposition
